newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen moving sideways in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen moving sideways in cautious trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to move sideways on Tuesday with players cautiously waiting for the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy meeting on interest rates later in the day, brokers said.

"The market has tended to trend up but investors are a bit cautious and the main index is likely to trade within a 100-point range today," said Peter So, deputy head of research at Schroder Securities.
The Hang Seng Index closed 46.45 points higher at 14,108.82 on Monday. The Hang Seng London Reference Index later added another 17.82 points to 14,126.64.
